unresolved_contract: Earlier reads can observe a different time-varying SRAM parity/permission/Host-write state; all checks retained but exact historical observation time is not proved equivalent
Input/output alias requires fallback; no bypass cache or shortened required INT32 producer lifetime
Trace-conditioned contention assumes other client schedule fixed; request rescheduling changes round-robin phase and descriptor overlap
Prefetched errors must be latched and retired in original group order; reset/abort must drain/discard epoch without duplicate completion
Read-time fault checks occur on actual new request/response; no output published before dependency and response validation; private protection configuration changes during lease require contract
